inputs.text: In South Dakota, Governor Larry Rhoden signed Senate Bill 175 on Thursday, forcing new voter registrants to prove U.S. citizenship just to cast ballots in state elections. Even though officials claim this only targets fresh sign-ups and state races, it's another clear attempt by those in power to erect barriers that slam hardest into immigrants, working people, and communities of color. These groups already battle deep systemic obstacles tied to historical exclusion and inequality when trying to gather the required paperwork. Moves like this put concentrated authority ahead of any real expansion of democratic access for the vulnerable. We need to challenge these restrictions head-on and push for the structural reforms that can actually deliver justice.
